name: ISAAC BUSEE
title: Software Engineer
careerSummary: A professional individual with over seven years of software development. Innovative and passionate about web design, adaptation, and maintenance. Hard worker, fast learner, and a team player who is proficient in a variety of multimedia web tools and scripting languages. Currently seeking opportunities in front-end and back-end web development roles.

projects.name: Buy and Selling Platform
projects.description: Built a full-stack application to connect vendors and buyers.
highlights: Leveraged GitHub Copilot to build server-side applications with Node.js, Mongoose, and Express to create reusable APIs for server-side rendering.
Leveraged React with Vite to build a modern, high-performing, scalable, and interactive UI application.
Implemented built-in React hooks such as useState, useReducer, useEffect, and useContext to build a scalable application.
Integrated third-party payment gateway APIs such as PayPal and Stripe for in-app transactions.

projects.name: E-commerce App MERN
projects.description: Engineered a scalable application to connect buyers and vendors.
highlights: Used ReactJS for the UI and Node.js with Express to build a scalable full-stack application.
Implemented useContext and useReducer hooks to manage state and send complex AJAX requests to backend services.
Deployed the application on AWS serverless and EC2 for continuous deployment and integration of application features.
Implemented Git version control and GitHub Actions to build application features and enable CI/CD.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs and payment gateway features with PayPal and Stripe.

projects.name: Memories Project
projects.description: Engineered a full-stack application for users to connect and post memorable events as well as interact with one another.
highlights: Used Node.js, Mongoose, and Express to design and set up the server-side application.
Used RESTful APIs to connect MongoDB Atlas and designed schemas for the project.
Used React on the client side with Axios and Material-UI to create an interactive UI.
Used React Router DOM and JSON Web Tokens for user authentication.

experience.title: Software Engineer
